config_dir.description: Base directory for fnott runtime files (e.g., state, pid, icons cache)

font.description: Font name and size for notification text (e.g., 'DejaVu Sans 9')

icon_theme.description: Name of the icon theme to use (e.g., 'Adwaita'); leave empty to use system default

autostart.description: Whether to automatically start fnott at user login

max_notifications.description: Maximum number of notifications visible on screen at once

notification_timeout.description: Default duration (in seconds) before a notification expires

margin.description: Pixels of space between notifications and the screen edge

scale.description: Scaling factor for notification size (e.g., 0.9 = 90% size)

log_file.description: Path to write logs to (e.g., '/var/log/fnott.log'); leave empty to log only to stderr

outputs.description: List of output (display) names to show notifications on (e.g., ['eDP-1', 'HDMI-A-1']); empty = all outputs

position.description: Vertical position of notifications: top, center, bottom

hposition.description: Horizontal position when `position` is not center: left, center, right

group_by_app.description: Group notifications from the same app into a single stack

default_urgency.description: Default urgency level for new notifications: low, normal, critical

suppressed_app_ids.description: List of application IDs (e.g., 'firefox.desktop') to suppress notifications from

items.description: Desktop file name of the application (e.g., 'slack.desktop')

action_timeout.description: Seconds before action buttons disappear (0 = never expire)
